name: footer-row
title: Footer row
description: The row every post, ad and deck ends on: the lockup on the left, the domain on the right. Links between them make it a website footer.
use_for: The foot of a page, a post, an ad or a slide. The domain in DM Sans, or in capitals as the posts set it.
never: The lockup on the right or centered with the domain
Social icons in place of the domain
source: Figma page 8: every post and ad's Spyglass lockup (183x28 at 64 or 72 from the edge) and spyglass.so text on one line; posts set the domain in capitals
